name: SUM
recent: Sum Technology 近期完成以 RM2,000,000 收购 INI Technologies 51% 股权，并宣布获得总值 RM8.12 million 的四项工程合约。公司同时从 Maybank Islamic 获得 RM30 million 伊斯兰银行融资设施。
notable: 完成以 RM2,000,000 收购 INI Technologies Sdn. Bhd. 51% 股权。
获得四项总值 RM8.12 million 的工程合约。
获得 Maybank Islamic 提供 RM30 million 伊斯兰银行融资设施。
risks: 大股东 MR NG YEW SUM 在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月期间多次申报股权变动。
独立非执行主席 DATO SRI MOHAMMAD NADJION BIN NASIR 在 2026 年 9 月至 10 月期间多次申报其儿子在公开市场交易公司股份。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止期间，公司录得营收 RM18,006,000，净利 RM92,000，净利率 0.5%。

recent_en: Sum Technology recently completed the acquisition of a 51% stake in INI Technologies for RM2,000,000 and announced four engineering contracts worth RM8.12 million. The company also secured RM30 million in Islamic banking facilities from Maybank Islamic.
notable_en: Completed the acquisition of a 51% equity interest in INI Technologies Sdn. Bhd. for RM2,000,000.
Secured four engineering contracts worth RM8.12 million in total.
Obtained RM30 million in Islamic banking facilities from Maybank Islamic.
risks_en: Substantial shareholder MR NG YEW SUM made multiple notifications of changes in his interest between September and November 2026.
Independent Non-Executive Chairman DATO SRI MOHAMMAD NADJION BIN NASIR made multiple notifications of his son's open market dealings in the company's shares between September and October 2026.
earnings_en: For the period ended 30 June 2026, the company recorded revenue of RM18,006,000 and net profit of RM92,000, with a net margin of 0.5%.
